scope: Shared D3D8/9 Win32 mode/style/foreground policy with typed bindings and scoped WM_SIZE filtering on Reset and CreateDevice. Covers window/fullscreen/resolution/target replacement, supported full constructors, unsupported constructor/Reset cleanup and desktop restoration. Physical mode failure can follow queued host commands. Exact focus-window policy, full refresh/bit-depth normalization, all constructor flags, concurrent subclass mutation, physical device loss, native HAL and game/FPS remain outside this step.

documentation.fact: CDS_FULLSCREEN is temporary; NULL with flags zero restores the registry mode; unsupported modes return failure.

facts.nativeTest: d3d9-device-tests.c test_reset_fullscreen, lines 4808 onward: window-to-fullscreen and fullscreen resize, suppress WM_SIZE recursion
